WITH TRU AS
(
    SELECT
    ---(SELECT TRU_DATE FROM eds.EDS_CTL) AS AS_OF_DATE
    CAST('2023-03-21' AS DATE) AS AS_OF_DATE
    ,CUST.UNIQUE_ID AS CUSTOMER_ID
    ,'TRU' AS SOURCE
    ,PORT.PORTFOLIO_NO AS ACCOUNT
    ,PORT.PORTFOLIO_NAME AS ACCOUNT_NAME
    ,PORT.STATUS AS ACCOUNT_STATUS
    ,PORT.SUB_BR_CD AS SOL_ID
    ,CASE WHEN BASE.PRIMARY_FLAG = 'Y' THEN 'Primary Holder'
        ELSE 'Non-Primary Holder' END ACCOUNT_HOLDER_TYPE
    ,PFSUB.INCEPTION_DATE AS OPENING_DATE
    ,NULL AS CLOSING_DATE
    ,NULL AS AREA
    ,NULL AS REGION
    ,PORT.PROD_CODE AS PRODUCT_CODE
    ,'Trust' AS PRODUCT_APPLICATION
    ,0 AS DEP_YTD_ADB_PHP
    ,0 AS DEP_OUT_BAL_PHP
    ,0 AS LNS_RELATIONSHIP_EXPOSURE_PHP
    ,0 AS CCD_RELATIONSHIP_EXPOSURE_PHP
    ,(COALESCE(UITF.TOTAL_FUND_VALUE_IN_PHP,0) + COALESCE(NONUITF.AUM_IN_ORIG_CURR,0)) AS TRUST_FUND_VALUE
    ,0 AS TRY_OUTSTANDING_INVESTMENT
    ,CUST.BNK_CODE
    FROM eds.TRU_CUST AS CUST
        LEFT JOIN eds.TRU_BASELINK AS BASE
            ON CUST.CUST_NO = BASE.CIF_NO
            AND CAST('2023-03-21' AS DATE) BETWEEN BASE.SCD_START_DATE AND BASE.SCD_END_DATE
        LEFT JOIN eds.TRU_PORTFOLIO AS PORT
            ON BASE.CUST_NO = PORT.BASE_NO
            AND CAST('2023-03-21' AS DATE) BETWEEN PORT.SCD_START_DATE AND PORT.SCD_END_DATE
        LEFT JOIN eds.TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION PFSUB
            ON PORT.SUBSCRIPTION_ID = PFSUB.SUBSCRIPTION_ID
            AND PORT.BASE_NO = PFSUB.BASE_NO
            AND CAST('2023-03-21' AS DATE) BETWEEN PFSUB.SCD_START_DATE AND PFSUB.SCD_END_DATE
        LEFT JOIN eds.TRU_AUMNONUITF NONUITF
            ON NONUITF.BASE_NO = PORT.BASE_NO
            AND NONUITF.PF_NO = PORT.PORTFOLIO_NO
            AND CAST('2023-03-21' AS DATE) BETWEEN NONUITF.SCD_START_DATE AND NONUITF.SCD_END_DATE
        LEFT JOIN eds.TRU_AUMUITF UITF
            ON UITF.BASE_NO = PORT.BASE_NO
            AND UITF.PORTFOLIO_NO = PORT.PORTFOLIO_NO
            AND CAST('2023-03-21' AS DATE) BETWEEN UITF.SCD_START_DATE AND UITF.SCD_END_DATE
    WHERE 
	CAST('2023-03-21' AS DATE) BETWEEN CUST.SCD_START_DATE AND CUST.SCD_END_DATE
        AND PORT.STATUS = 'A'
)
SELECT 
        ACCOUNT as AccountID
    ,   CUSTOMER_ID as CustomerID
    ,   concat('Entity_CIF_CRM_', CUSTOMER_ID) as EntityCIF
    ,   CUSTOMER_ID as FCBSCIF
    ,   BNK_CODE as Bank_Code --
    ,   SOL_ID as Branch_Code
    ,   NULL as Branch_Name
    ,   AREA as Area
    ,   REGION as Region
    ,   SOURCE as Source
    ,   NULL as ProductGrouping
    ,   PRODUCT_CODE as ProductType
    ,   NULL as ProductDetails
    ,   OPENING_DATE as OpenedDate
    ,   TRUST_FUND_VALUE as AssetsUnderManagementBalance_Full
    ,   NULL as AssetsUnderManagementBalance_Prorated
    ,   CAST('2023-03-21' AS DATE) as LastUpdatedDate 
    ,   concat(ACCOUNT, CUSTOMER_ID, BNK_CODE, SOURCE) as AccountKey
FROM TRU
WHERE left(CUSTOMER_ID, 1) = 'R'
